title: loadsheet Scan

tool.description: The tool and version that wrote it, such as loadsheet@0.0.1.

scannedAt.description: When it was scanned, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

items.description: A UTC calendar day, written YYYY-MM-DD.
A UTC calendar day, written YYYY-MM-DD.

window.description: The first and last day it covers, inclusive.

installed.description: Whether the harness's home exists on that machine.

versions.description: Harness versions seen in those sessions.

firstDay.description: The first day with a session.

lastDay.description: The last day with a session.

listing.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

modelUse.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

userUse.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

instructions.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

mcp.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

tokens.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

usage.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

cacheTtl.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

turns.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

hours.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

tools.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

limits.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

signals.description: How well each signal is provided.

contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens, as the harness reports it in its latest session or, failing that, its settings; absent when unknown.

settingsPath.description: The active settings.json, only when it can be named relative to home.

cacheTtl.description: How long the main conversation's prompt cache lives, as the settings set it.

cacheTtlFrom.description: Which knob set cacheTtl, such as `settings.promptCacheTtl`, `env.FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M` or `default`.

subagentCacheTtl.description: How long a subagent's prompt cache lives, as the settings set it.

caching.description: Whether prompt caching is on or turned off.

cachingFrom.description: Which variable turned caching off, such as `settings.env.DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING`; absent when it is on.

retentionDays.description: Days the harness keeps a transcript before it deletes it.

docMaxBytes.description: The most bytes of an instruction file the harness reads.

autoCompact.description: Whether the harness compacts a conversation on its own when its context fills.

autoCompactWindow.description: The context size in tokens at which the harness compacts on its own.

settings.description: What the harness's settings and environment set, as derived values, never their text; absent when the harness reads none.

unread.description: The session stores of this harness that could not be read, by name, such as `opencode.db`; absent when every store was read.

items.description: What one harness on one machine could tell.

coverage.description: What each harness on this machine could tell.

kind.description: What the piece of context is.

name.description: Its name, unique within its kind.

harnesses.description: Ids of the harnesses that load it from this path.

pack.description: Where it came from: a plugin name, `owner/repo`, or a fleetrc source.

path.description: Its file or folder, relative to the home directory (`~/...`) or to the project.

items.description: Its file or folder, relative to the home directory (`~/...`) or to the project.

reaches.description: The paths of the other Items of this machine that removing this one would take or break, worked out on the machine's disk; absent when that is not known.

digest.description: The sha256 of its file content, as lowercase hex.

listed.description: Characters it puts in the context of every session that lists or loads it: a skill's or subagent's name and description, an instruction file's whole text, an MCP server's instructions.

body.description: Characters loaded only when it is invoked: the rest of a skill's or subagent's file; 0 for instruction files and MCP servers.

chars.description: Its size in characters: listed is paid by every session that lists or loads it, body only by a session that invokes it.

modelInvocable.description: Whether the model may invoke it on its own.

description.description: A skill's or subagent's description, the text the harness lists for it; absent for other kinds.

items.description: One installed piece of context found on disk (or in a pack). The same id at two paths is two Items.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions.

fixedTokens.description: First-request input tokens, summed over the sessions that reported them.

measured.description: Sessions that reported their first-request input tokens.

items.description: Additive session totals for one harness, day and entrypoint: the denominator for every share.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions, such as cli or an app's name.

sessions.description: Sessions that listed it (skill, mcp, subagent) or loaded it (instructions).

bare.description: Of those sessions, how many listed it without its description.

chars.description: Characters it occupied, summed over those sessions.

items.description: Additive usage counters for one item, in one harness, on one day, through one entrypoint.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions.

project.description: The project the sessions ran in: `owner/repo`, a folder under the home directory (`~/...`), an absolute path outside it, or `unknown`.

thread.description: Whether these are main conversations or subagents' conversations.

sessions.description: Sessions started; a subagent's conversation counts as one.

compacted.description: Of those sessions, how many compacted their context at least once.

compactions.description: Compactions in those sessions, automatic and manual.

manualCompactions.description: Of those compactions, how many the user asked for.

items.description: Additive session counters for one project, harness, day, entrypoint and thread.

day.description: The day the requests were made.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions.

project.description: The project the sessions ran in: `owner/repo`, a folder under the home directory (`~/...`), an absolute path outside it, or `unknown`.

thread.description: Whether the requests came from main conversations or subagents' conversations.

model.description: The model the requests went to, as the harness names it.

input.description: Input tokens sent without the prompt cache: neither read from it nor written to it.

reasoning.description: Of the output tokens, how many were reasoning.

cacheRead.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

cacheWrite.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

cacheWrite5m.description: Of the cache writes, the tokens written to a cache that lives 5 minutes.

cacheWrite1h.description: Of the cache writes, the tokens written to a cache that lives 1 hour; with cacheWrite5m at most cacheWrite, and the rest unsplit.

cacheRewrite.description: Five-minute cache writes 5 to 60 minutes after a request to the same model in the conversation: possible reuse with a longer cache, not guaranteed hits.

items.description: Additive token counters for one project, harness, day, entrypoint, thread and model.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions.

project.description: The project the sessions ran in: `owner/repo`, a folder under the home directory (`~/...`), an absolute path outside it, or `unknown`.

thread.description: Whether the turns were in main conversations or subagents' conversations.

interrupted.description: Of those turns, how many the user interrupted.

timed.description: Of those turns, how many have a measured duration.

durationMs.description: The summed duration of the timed turns, in milliseconds.

toolCalls.description: Tool calls the model made in those turns.

withSubagents.description: Of those turns, how many started at least one subagent.

items.description: Additive turn counters for one project, harness, day, entrypoint and thread. A turn is one prompt and the work the agent did for it.

turns.description: Turn counters; absent when no harness read reports turns.

hour.description: The UTC hour of the day, 0 to 23.

thread.description: Whether the activity was in main conversations or subagents' conversations.

requests.description: Model requests made in that hour.

items.description: Additive activity counters for one harness, day, hour and thread.

hours.description: Activity by hour of the day; absent when no harness read reports it.

thread.description: Whether the calls were made in main conversations or subagents' conversations.

tool.description: The tool: a built-in tool's name, `mcp:<server>` for any tool of an MCP server, or `other` for a name loadsheet does not keep.

items.description: Additive tool-call counters for one harness, day, thread and tool.

tools.description: Tool calls by tool; absent when no harness read reports them.

windowMinutes.description: The window's length in minutes, such as 300 or 10080; 0 when the harness does not say.

usedPercent.description: The share of the window used at the latest reading, in percent; absent when there was none.

at.description: When the latest reading was taken, in seconds since the epoch; absent with usedPercent.

resetsAt.description: When the window resets, as of the latest reading, in seconds since the epoch; absent when unknown.

peakUsedPercent.description: The highest share used at any reading that day, in percent; absent with usedPercent.

reached.description: How many times the limit was reached.

items.description: One harness's rate-limit window on one day: the latest reading of how much of it is used, and how often the limit was hit. A gauge, not a sum: merging two keeps the later reading and the higher peak, and sums `reached`.

limits.description: Rate-limit readings; absent when no harness read reports them.

usage.description: Sessions and tokens per project; absent when no harness read reports them.

description: One machine's counters for a window: what is installed and how it was used, with no text. Scans of the same machine merge by summing their counters; Scans of different machines stay separate, and a Report is built from the list.
